title: learnings — the rules a ralph run proposes for future runs (docs/ralph C9)
description: The ralph learn agent's output. Nothing applies it: learn_post posts the surviving entries as one comment on the target repository's `ralph learnings` issue and a human decides. The evidence check (a path:N or a backticked command) is learn_post's, because it needs the checkout to test the path; the schema only bounds the count and the vocabulary. _io is stamped by the server.

learnings.description: At most five rules. [] is a good answer: a run that learned nothing should say so.

rule.description: One sentence a future run in this repository should follow. About the repository, or about how ralph should work; never about this issue.

evidence.description: The Task id, Iteration or Refute round that showed it, plus a path:N or the failing command. No evidence, no entry: learn_post drops it.

home.description: Where the rule would live if a human accepts it: AGENTS.md, .fabro/test.toml, .fabro/ci.sh, or a ralph prompt in this repository.
